image_description: A street scene featuring a traffic light assembly mounted on a metal pole against an overcast sky. The primary subject is a vertical traffic signal with three circular lenses; the top lens is illuminated red. To the right, a horizontal pedestrian signal displays an orange 'Don't Walk' hand symbol. A green highway sign labeled '101' is visible below the signals. Dark tree foliage occupies the bottom of the frame.

The connection point between the horizontal pedestrian signal and the main pole is vague and lacks clear mechanical detail, appearing to float slightly rather than being rigidly mounted.
